name: BuildAPendant
author: belgiumwebnetinc

sections.description:
BuildAPendant is a powerful pendant builder with custom styles, profiles, widths, and finishes.

Features

  • Personalize pendants with attributes like profile, metal type, and color.
  • Adjust width (mm) and thickness to achieve the perfect fit and style.
  • Add custom finishes to enhance the pendant’s texture and final look.
  • Preview pendant designs in real time for a seamless shopping experience.
  • Add your custom pendant directly to cart and proceed to WordPress checkout.

sections.installation:
1. Go to your WordPress dashboard → Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  2. Upload the buildapendant.zip file.
  3. Activate the plugin.
  4. Add the shortcode [buildapendant] to any page.
sections.faq:
How do I display the builder on my page?

Use the shortcode [buildapendant] anywhere you want the builder to appear.

Can I customize the look and feel of the design?

Yes, you can customize the styles by editing the CSS file located in the assets/css/ folder.
